_meta.description: Machine-readable behavioural evidence layer. Contains ONLY behaviour claims graded PASSIVELY_OBSERVED or CONTROLLED_VERIFIED, each with evidence references. Deliberately separate from the frozen structural model (VANILLA-HELPDESK.json, tag VANILLA-HELPDESK-STRUCTURAL-v1) — structural truth and behaviour truth must not be mixed.

grades.PASSIVELY_OBSERVED: Footprint found in situ without a controlled experiment; causation not isolated.
grades.CONTROLLED_VERIFIED: Confirmed by a controlled experiment (single variable, before/after captured).

behaviours.claim: A Helpdesk-type tag with TextMatch auto-attaches to a new job whose description contains the phrase, at creation time.
RH01 creates Reactive jobs in With Helpdesk (type creation default).

SLA targets are computed on the Response category's working-hours clock: P2 raised Wed 00:29 out-of-hours yields required response Fri 14:30 (24 working hours from Wed 08:30) and completion Mon 08:30 (3 working days) on Standard hours Mon-Fri 08:30-17:30.
RH02 moves With Helpdesk -> With Maintenance Team - R and auto-adds tag '01. Team assigned'.
RH03 keeps the job in With Maintenance Team - R (configured self-loop) and swaps tags 01 -> '03. Engineer assigned'.
RH10 moves WMT-R -> Work Complete - R, records the actual response date entered, and advances tags to '08. Awaiting AFP/invoicing'.
G004 moves Work Complete - R -> Closed; job tag section clears.
G003 moves a job to Cancelled; the Reactive-tasks action group button disappears from the job toolbar (rendering follows availability).
Cancelled is a terminal, non-complete state: own status tab; included in the type-level job count; only Closed carries the complete flag.
The admin quick-add form requires Urgency (SLA applied at creation); the reporter Raise Job wizard collects no urgency and its jobs carry no SLA targets.

Web action surfaces render exactly the configured-available actions minus hide_from_use and wrong-PPM-type, partitioned by action group on the job toolbar (sampled: 3 statuses, administrator session).
Action email flags fire real email attempts; delivery fails in this environment ('Email failed to send' timeline entries after RH01).
residuals: cause not isolated: empty templates (VI-008) vs SMTP absence — E2 observes

behaviours.claim: Classification parent/child cascades into the admin form and auto-fills the short description ('Electrical : Socket').
